prompt_fragment: This asset is a sprite. Keep the silhouette clean and readable, with one clear focal subject and strong separation from the background.
raw_description:
A High-Beak Auditor in full ceremonial warlord regalia, seen in a slight
3/4 overhead angle. Long ice-bladed sword held low, pale prismatic glyph
script hanging in the air around the free hand as he reads the ice-memory.
Black eye patch over one eye, a long scar across the beak. Posture of
command — mid-council and mid-campaign at once.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor illustration, richly pigmented, game-poster saturation, single clean sprite silhouette on neutral parchment ground. Adult emperor penguin, tall and lean with narrow pointed beak, small dark eyes proportional to the skull, upright commanding posture — wearing pale ice-plate and segmented silvered armor over flowing white robes, aurora-crystal coronet, prismatic-tipped stave at rest and ice-bladed sword held low. A black eye patch covers one eye; a long healed scar crosses the beak. Rank glyphs in Chinese-influenced script are etched into the breastplate. Cool aurora-green light pulses at polished pauldron rims and floats as prismatic glyph-script around the raised free hand, reading the ice-memory. Slight three-quarter overhead angle, strong silhouette separation, deep slate shadows, clean whites, vivid emerald aurora highlights against silvered steel and pale sky-blue ice-plate.
